sub: How much land each crop covers on the registered farms, where it is grown and how much harvest to expect, and the list of crops the app offers.
none_title: No crop is painted on any farm yet
none_text: Crops appear when farmers paint them on their fields in the app.
no_land: No land of this crop yet.
estimate_note: Harvest is an estimate: dunam × a typical harvest per dunam. It is not a measurement.
code_hint: Small English letters and _, 2 to 24. It never changes.
code_bad: Use 2 to 24 small English letters or _.
code_taken: A crop with this code already exists.
yield_hint: Leave empty when not known. Reports show "-" then.
yield_bad: Write a number above 0, or leave it empty.
active_hint: Switched off: farmers cannot pick it any more; farms that have it keep it.
delete_text: The crop is removed from the list. A crop that farms or Alwa still use cannot be deleted.
in_use_text: Farms or Alwa still use this crop, so it cannot be deleted. Switch it off instead: farmers cannot pick it any more, existing farms keep it.
local_note: You cannot open the server's crop table, so this is the list the site knows.
yield_note: Harvest per dunam comes from the crop table. Where it is empty, expected harvest shows "-": the site never guesses it.
